sloka: धन्याः खलु महात्मानो मुनयः सत्यसंमताः ।जितात्मानो महाभागा येषां न स्तः प्रियाप्रिये ।। ५.२४.४७।।।।
transliteration: dhanyāḥ khalu mahātmāno munayaḥ satyasaṁmatāḥ ।jitātmāno mahābhāgā yeṣāṁ na staḥ priyāpriye ।। 5.24.47।।।।

translations.english: 'Get the wine quickly, destroyer of all sorrows. After relishing the human flesh we will start Nikumbhila dance.'
